programme.desc: Bella adalah pontianak yang cantik namun sering menjadi mangsa lelaki buaya. Bella jadi berhati-hati dalam bercinta. Namun Malik juga khianatinya lalu Bella arahkan Amran dan Zafran serang Malik!

programme.title: Rombongan Cik Kiah Ke Kelana Jaya
programme.desc: Kisah rombongan yang dikendalikan oleh Cik Kiah untuk menghantar Encik Isnin ke Kelana Jaya sebelum berlepas ke Tanah Suci bagi mengerjakan haji. Lakonan Chacha Maembong, Imuda, Syuk SYJ, Delimawati, Man Kadir, Hazwan, Sharwani NS dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Karya 12-Eropah, Here I Am
programme.desc: Bukhary membawa diri ke Pulau Leros, Greece dan menjadi sukarelawan membantu pelarian Syiria. Di situ dia mempelajari nilai kehidupan dan kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Karya 12 Vol 2: Ilham!
programme.desc: Ilham, seorang pengarah teater yang sedang dalam produksi 'Lelaki Jalan Timur' menghadapi detik kesukaran dalam hidup dan kerjaya. Teater tersebut tentang kehidupan sempurna, namun skrip itu belum siap sepenuhnya.

programme.title: Oh Mak Kau
programme.desc: Dua beradik suka mencuri dan membuat ibu mereka marah sehinggalah kehadiran Que yang berjaya memikat hati mereka.

programme.title: i-Tanggang Ep6
programme.desc: Sepanjang hidupnya, Khalil sakit akibat ubat yang diberi oleh ibunya, Erma sehingga menyebabkan dia selalu pengsan. Syafiq pula terpaksa keluar bekerja mencari nafkah untuk keluarganya.

programme.title: Angkara Dendam
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Khomein yang cemburu pada kembarnya Tehra kerana ibubapa mereka memberi kasih sayang dan perhatian yang lebih kepada Tehra sehingga dia merancang sesuatu untuk mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Lemak Kampung Santan
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda kota bernama Ridzuan jatuh cinta dengan gadis kampung bernama Tiqa. Tetapi percintaan mereka tidak semudah yang disangka.

programme.title: Sepenggal Puisi Ep8
programme.desc: Rahsia yang di simpan selama 30 tahun akhirnya terbongkar dan menimbulkan konflik dalam 2 buah keluarga yang berada di Kuala Lumpur dan juga Yogyakarta.

programme.title: Kami The Movie
programme.desc: Lima sahabat karib berkongsi kisah suka duka kehidupan termasuklah konflik keluarga, penyalahgunaan dadah, cinta dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Aku, Mawar & Makhluk Asing
programme.desc: Apabila tunang yang garang tiba-tiba berubah menjadi seorang wanita yang lemah lembut, maka Bart jatuh cinta kembali pada tunangnya, Mawar. Tapi, adakah itu Mawar yang sebenar?

programme.title: Bidaah Ep6
programme.desc: Bimbang dengan ketaksuban ibunya kepada Walid Muhammad, pemimpin misteri Jihad Ummah, Baiduri berusaha untuk membongkar kebenaran di sebalik ajaran kumpulan itu.

programme.title: A Deadly Legend
programme.desc: Joan Huntar, seorang pemaju hartanah, membeli sebuah kem musim panas yang lama. Ternyata hartanah itu pernah didiami oleh sekumpulan orang penyangak dengan sejarah hitam.

programme.title: The Kid With the Golden Arm

programme.title: The Merry Wife

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies - and raising them - is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires - like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep3
programme.desc: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered 'pests.' But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they're not welcome.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep5
programme.desc: There's strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle's master builder: the orangutan.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he's a friend, not a foe.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar.

programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar.

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2 Ep3
programme.desc: Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fish's eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep3
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the 'underwater movie capital of the world'. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Florida is famous for its sandy shores-and there's plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep2
programme.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep3
programme.desc: The mythology of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula includes a protective Earth Mother figure, 'Ixchel,' who brings fertility and healing to the region.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Throughout the Hawaiian Islands, natural forces of creation and destruction can be observed in real-time as they work to shape the living beach.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep5
programme.desc: It's a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest sand island on earth, and home to wild dingoes, six-foot sand-worms, and eucalyptus woodlands.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep6
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankind's effects on nature?

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years' worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earth's oddest creatures.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the ocean's most peculiar creatures.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand's Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild S3 Ep1
